caption: The drawing depicts a large, cylindrical stoneware jug with a wide mouth and a slightly flared rim. The jug has two small, curved handles attached near the top on opposite sides. The body of the jug is grayish-beige, suggesting the natural color of the stoneware material, with areas of subtle shading to indicate roundness and depth. The interior of the jug, visible from the top, is a reddish-brown color, likely indicating the unglazed clay. The surface of the jug features a decorative cobalt blue design on the upper front portion, consisting of a stylized floral motif above two curved, abstract shapes. The arrangement and coloration suggest traditional hand-painted decoration. The background is plain, and the focus is entirely on the jug, with no additional objects or scenery included in the composition.
title: Jar
